# Provenance of the vendored ETSformer (decision D-12, gap G-36)

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/salesforce/ETSformer (official implementation of the ETSformer paper) |
| Pinned commit | `082555c3638d80dcc7655fc5f316b5a18fd93867` (tip of `main` when fetched, 2026-09-28; read from the tarball's git header) |
| Fetched as | `codeload.github.com/salesforce/ETSformer/tar.gz/refs/heads/main`, tarball sha256 `debd9cc6a81b146455c6fadf2ea038a836534d8663eea2e1180f1b794342577a` |
| Licence | BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2022 Salesforce.com, Inc. -- verbatim in `LICENSE.txt` (notice retained as the licence requires) |
| Modifications | **none**: every vendored file is byte-identical to the pinned commit (`FILES.sha256.json`, checked by `tests/test_etsformer_g36.py` and by `oss_scan.py`) |
| Vendored | only `src/models/etsformer/{model,encoder,decoder,exponential_smoothing,modules}.py` (+ empty `__init__.py`) |
| Not vendored | `run.py`, `exp/`, `data_provider/`, `utils/`, `scripts/`, `dataset/`, `pics/` -- the upstream training/experiment pipeline; this system has its own (torch_base.py) |
| Exposure | only behind `algorithms/etsformer.py` (the algorithm adapter); nothing else imports the vendored tree |

## Archived status
The matrix records (Verification Log) that the upstream repository was archived by its owner on 2026-06-25 and is read-only,
so no upstream fixes will arrive and this commit is the permanent source. **This was not re-verified here**: the GitHub API was
rate-limited in the build environment, so the archive banner was not fetched again.

## Compatibility test (matrix G-36: "an import/run compatibility test on the target Python is required")
Upstream's README declares Python 3.8 and pins torch 1.11. The unmodified files import, run forward and backward and train on
Python 3.12 with torch 2.14 (`tests/test_etsformer_g36.py`); the only message is torch's `meshgrid` deprecation warning.
Runtime dependencies beyond torch: `einops`, `scipy` (`scipy.fftpack.next_fast_len`), `numpy`.

## Code it builds on
The upstream README names https://github.com/thuml/Autoformer (MIT) and https://github.com/zhouhaoyi/Informer2020 (Apache-2.0).
`OSS_SCAN.md` (generated by `oss_scan.py`) measures code overlap of the vendored files against both repositories, at
Autoformer commit `51c7d416ae120b805fd5beef2f4ccf7de496a6ff` (tarball sha256 `bc4cf20fad1b0b66...`) and Informer2020 commit
`29f2a739226a509202a092b464163da81fa74960` (tarball sha256 `d9f9e0483db9a063...`).
